mechanism: Pyrazinamide causes hyperuricemia and can precipitate gout; torsemide (loop diuretic) also increases serum uric acid levels and reduces uric acid excretion, compounding hyperuricemia risk.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and gout symptoms; consider alternative antituberculosis regimen or add urate-lowering therapy (allopurinol/febuxostat) if combination is necessary.
